source_semantics.show_all: The source Sites workspace exposes ShowAllSites to select the all-sites view rather than narrowing the already loaded tenant collection.
source_semantics.read_only: ShowAllSites is browser-local view state. It does not persist data, enqueue work, call a provider mutation, or fabricate mutation success.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/pages.tsx binds AIMW-CONT-C178278FCB only to the All control on the real Sites ResourceContent workspace.
laravel_adaptation.view_state: The Sites workspace owns an explicit local all/connected filter state. ShowAllSites sets that state to all and renders the complete current authoritative Sites result.
laravel_adaptation.read_contract: The control operates over rows already returned by the existing tenant Sites query; clicking All does not issue an additional request.
laravel_adaptation.mutation_boundary: The control performs no mutation. Refresh, selection, bulk-delete, and later connection filters remain distinct canonical operations.
